description.fun: Litten is an aloof little cat that doesn't show its feelings and scratches anyone who tries to pet it before earning its trust. The fur it swallows while grooming becomes fuel: it sets the hairballs alight and coughs up fireballs, and when it moults it burns off its whole oily coat in a blaze. Its forehead stripes and eyes form the alchemical symbol for sulfur.
description.guide: Litten is a Fire-type cat Pokémon and one of the three first partner Pokémon of Alola in Sun and Moon. It is solitary and slow to trust, and it spits fireballs made by igniting the fur it collects while grooming. It evolves into Torracat and then Incineroar.
description.tagline: An aloof kitten that coughs up flaming hairballs

description.fun: Torracat wears its fire as a bell: the glowing organ at its throat is its flame sac, burning hotter with its mood and ringing brightly when it breathes fire. Its whiskers sense foes in the dark and droop when it's feeling poorly, and its front paws can bend iron with one blow. With its Trainer it acts like a spoiled child, but it still leaves its friends covered in scratches.
description.guide: Torracat is a Fire-type Pokémon, the middle stage of Litten's line. The bell-like flame sac at its neck powers its fire attacks and reacts to its emotions, and its mane helps it sense its surroundings. It loves to battle and is more affectionate with its Trainer than Litten.
description.tagline: A fiery tiger cat with a ringing bell at its throat

description.fun: Incineroar is a pro wrestler and a heel: a tiger in a striped singlet with a championship belt made of fire bursting from its waist. It fights dirty, sometimes even hitting the opposing Trainer, lives for the roar of the crowd and gets bored by weak opponents. Secretly, it's delighted when children admire it and happily helps small Pokémon, like a villain keeping up kayfabe.
description.guide: Incineroar is a Fire- and Dark-type Pokémon, the final form of Litten, based on a tiger and a professional wrestling villain. It fights with brutal punches and kicks and breathes fire from the flaming belt around its waist. Beneath its rough, showboating act it is kind to children and small Pokémon.
description.tagline: A heel wrestler tiger with a heart of gold under the act
